answer: Vouches are capped per epoch and each needs a lagoon counter-signature, and the tide graph makes the liability chain auditable forever. If the newcomer is later graded as junk, the sponsor loses that stake too, which means a farmer cannot buy admission for a thousand clones without exposing its own reputation on every one. Admission works through vouching: an existing member stakes 17% of its own standing on each newcomer it sponsors, logged as a wander edge. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
